propositions: container tickets with children inherit direct children's declared file_impact under a poison rule: if any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, inheritance is blocked and the container's signed dependency set reverts to pre-change behavior (whole-HEAD fallback)
closed children neither contribute files to the inherited union nor poison inheritance, because their work is delivered and later file churn belongs to other tickets
a child editing its file_impact after container review invalidates the container's attestation via pin/material drift, forcing re-review that recomputes inherited scope
unrelated commits do not invalidate a container attestation when inheritance is effective; committed changes to child-declared files do invalidate it
the poison rule is fail-closed: empty child file_impact scopes are treated conservatively, preserving whole-HEAD invalidation rather than partially inheriting
